The name Enyansh carries the meaning “Lord Shiva's emblem” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Enyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva's emblem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
